verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never says whether Fireflies uses meeting data to train AI models, never describes an org-level training opt-out, and never mentions SOC 2 or HIPAA. The security page does cite a 0-day retention policy with vendors and Private Storage, but these are adjacent data-handling controls. They are not a documented training policy or opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the vendor documents whether meeting data trains AI models and gives my org an enforceable opt-out, alongside SOC 2 / HIPAA posture
